$Comment: Artillery XP for the three bloom bombs, on a server running MMO Skill Tree: one row a bloom on the
Artillery track's own table, beside the rows MMO Skill Tree ships for it. Requires takes this file
out on a server without MMO Skill Tree, where there is no Artillery track to pay; always write it
A thrown bloom bursts after it leaves the hand, so by the time it lands the thrower may hold
something else. A tag: row ties the hit to the Hit tag each burst carries (the thrown item's own
id) instead of to whatever is in hand, so every hit the burst lands trains Artillery and takes
Artillery's damage bonuses. A tag: row is checked before cause: rows, so the Emberbloom's Fire
and the Gustbloom's Wind pay Artillery and never a school's row. The value is the XP each hit
pays. Each row names its burst's Hit tag, so keep the two spelled alike.
